meaning.en: To be thoroughly puzzled and unable to understand.
meaning.zh: 对事情非常疑惑，不能理解。

examples.zh: 他突然辞职，同事们大惑不解。
examples.en: His sudden resignation left his colleagues completely baffled.

examples.zh: 对这个决定，许多球迷大惑不解。
examples.en: Many fans were utterly baffled by the decision.

meaning.en: Guilty of crimes so heinous they cannot be forgiven.
meaning.zh: 罪恶极大，不可饶恕。

examples.zh: 他不是什么十恶不赦的坏人，只是一时糊涂。
examples.en: He's no irredeemable villain, just momentarily foolish.

examples.zh: 这个十恶不赦的罪犯终于落网了。
examples.en: The unpardonable criminal was finally caught.

usage.en: Attributive; originally one of ten grave offences in imperial law.
usage.zh: 多作定语；原指古代刑律中的“十恶”。

meaning.en: To carry out one's grand plans on a large scale.
meaning.zh: 充分施展远大的抱负和计划。

examples.zh: 祝你到新公司后大展宏图！
examples.en: Wishing you great success realising your ambitions at the new company.

examples.zh: 他回国创业，打算大展宏图。
examples.en: He returned home to start a business, intending to make a great mark.

usage.en: Often used as a good wish.

meaning.en: To say everything one has to say, holding nothing back.
meaning.zh: 把知道的话全都说出来，毫无保留。

examples.zh: 老朋友之间，向来知无不言，言无不尽。
examples.en: Between old friends, we always speak freely and hold nothing back.

examples.zh: 他对这个问题言无不尽。
examples.en: He told us everything he knew on the matter.

usage.en: Usually paired with 知无不言.

meaning.en: To be moved to steal or grab on seeing valuables.
meaning.zh: 看见钱财就起了贪心，想据为己有。

examples.zh: 他见财起意，偷走了客人的钱包。
examples.en: Tempted by the cash, he stole the guest's wallet.

examples.zh: 司机见财起意，没有归还乘客的行李。
examples.en: The driver, tempted by the valuables, did not return the passenger's luggage.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于案件报道。

meaning.en: To go from the surface to the heart of the matter.
meaning.zh: 从表面深入到内部、本质。

equivalents: from the surface to the core

examples.zh: 分析问题要由表及里。
examples.en: Analyse a problem by moving from the surface to the core.

examples.zh: 这篇评论由表及里，层层深入。
examples.en: The review digs deeper layer by layer.

usage.en: Often paired with 去粗取精.

natural: beat one's breast and stamp one's feet

meaning.en: To beat one's chest and stamp one's feet in grief, anger or regret.
meaning.zh: 捶打胸口，跺脚，形容极度悲痛、悔恨或愤怒。

examples.zh: 听说错过了末班车，他捶胸顿足。
examples.en: Hearing he'd missed the last train, he beat his breast in frustration.

examples.zh: 她捶胸顿足地后悔当初的决定。
examples.en: She bitterly regretted her earlier decision.

meaning.en: Funny enough to make one hold one's sides laughing.
meaning.zh: 让人笑得抱着肚子，形容非常可笑。

examples.zh: 这部喜剧小品令人捧腹。
examples.en: This comic sketch is hilarious.

examples.zh: 他讲的故事令人捧腹，大家笑个不停。
examples.en: His story was side-splitting; everyone kept laughing.

usage.en: Predicate; related to 捧腹大笑.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，与“捧腹大笑”相关。

meaning.en: Brilliantly bright and glorious.
meaning.zh: 光彩鲜明耀眼，多形容成就、前景或历史。

examples.zh: 中华文明有着光辉灿烂的历史。
examples.en: Chinese civilisation has a glorious history.

examples.zh: 他走过了光辉灿烂的一生。
examples.en: He lived a brilliant, glorious life.

usage.en: Attributive; fixed with 历史, 前景, 成就.
usage.zh: 多作定语，常修饰历史、前景、成就。

meaning.en: To overcome the enemy and win victory.
meaning.zh: 战胜敌人，取得胜利。

examples.zh: 这套战术帮助球队克敌制胜。
examples.en: This tactic helped the team beat its opponent.

examples.zh: 克敌制胜的关键在于出其不意。
examples.en: The key to defeating the enemy lies in catching him off guard.

usage.en: Predicate; also used in sport and business.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也用于体育和商业。

meaning.en: To shut the country's doors to the outside world.
meaning.zh: 封闭关口，对外不往来，指不与外国交往的政策。

examples.zh: 清朝后期的闭关锁国政策使中国落后了。
examples.en: The Qing dynasty's closed-door policy left China behind.

examples.zh: 闭关锁国只会让国家停滞不前。
examples.en: Closing the country off can only lead to stagnation.

meaning.en: To lavishly praise someone's achievements, often flatteringly.
meaning.zh: 颂扬功绩和德行，现多含讽刺意味。

examples.zh: 媒体不该只是为权贵歌功颂德。
examples.en: The media shouldn't merely sing the praises of the powerful.

examples.zh: 他写了一篇歌功颂德的文章。
examples.en: He wrote a fawning piece of praise.

meaning.en: Deeply stirring to the soul.
meaning.zh: 使人心灵深受震动。

examples.zh: 这场比赛的结局动人心魄。
examples.en: The ending of this match was thrilling to the core.

examples.zh: 她的歌声动人心魄。
examples.en: Her singing stirs the soul.

meaning.en: To show every possible care and concern.
meaning.zh: 关心照顾得无微不至。

equivalents: care for with the utmost attention

examples.zh: 老师对每个学生都关怀备至。
examples.en: The teacher cares attentively for every student.

examples.zh: 护士对病人关怀备至。
examples.en: The nurses look after patients with the utmost care.

meaning.en: To avoid the enemy's strong points and strike at the weak ones; also to dodge the main issue.
meaning.zh: 避开敌人的主力，攻击其薄弱处；也指回避主要问题。

examples.zh: 对强大的对手，要避实就虚。
examples.en: Against a strong opponent, avoid its strengths and hit its weak spots.

examples.zh: 他回答问题总是避实就虚。
examples.en: He always dodges the real point when answering.

usage.en: Predicate; in the second sense mildly negative.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；引申义略含贬义。

meaning.en: To exit one after another in a single line.
meaning.zh: 像游鱼一样一个接一个地走出来。

examples.zh: 下课铃一响，学生们鱼贯而出。
examples.en: As the bell rang, the students filed out.

examples.zh: 乘客们有序地鱼贯而出。
examples.en: The passengers filed out in an orderly line.

meaning.en: A polite plea to be let off lightly or shown leniency.
meaning.zh: 请求对方宽容、饶恕的客气话。

examples.zh: 这次是我的错，请您高抬贵手。
examples.en: It was my fault this time; please go easy on me.

examples.zh: 老板，高抬贵手，再宽限几天吧。
examples.en: Boss, please be lenient and give us a few more days.

usage.en: Used as a request; slightly humorous.

meaning.en: To think long and hard about a problem.
meaning.zh: 绞尽脑汁，深入地思索。

examples.zh: 他苦思冥想了一整夜，还是没有答案。
examples.en: He racked his brains all night but found no answer.

examples.zh: 她苦思冥想，终于想出了办法。
examples.en: After long thought she finally found a way.

meaning.en: Constantly thinking of and longing for something.
meaning.zh: 一直想着、惦记着。

examples.zh: 他心心念念想回老家看看。
examples.en: He constantly longs to go back to his hometown.

examples.zh: 这是她心心念念的新手机。
examples.en: This is the new phone she has been dreaming of.

meaning.en: To analyse in an orderly, meticulous way.
meaning.zh: 有条理、细致地分析。

examples.zh: 他对案情条分缕析，十分清楚。
examples.en: He analysed the case point by point, very clearly.

examples.zh: 这份报告条分缕析，说服力很强。
examples.en: The report is meticulously analysed and very convincing.

meaning.en: Fluttering in the breeze.
meaning.zh: 迎着风飘动，多指旗帜等。

examples.zh: 国旗在广场上迎风招展。
examples.en: The national flag flutters in the wind on the square.

examples.zh: 彩旗迎风招展，一片喜庆。
examples.en: Coloured flags fluttered in the breeze, festive all around.

meaning.en: Idle gossip and petty remarks.
meaning.zh: 没有根据的议论，或不满意的话。

examples.zh: 别理会那些闲言碎语。
examples.en: Don't mind the idle gossip.

examples.zh: 村里的闲言碎语让她很苦恼。
examples.en: The village gossip distressed her.

meaning.en: Servilely agreeing to everything without a view of one's own.
meaning.zh: 一味顺从，不敢提出自己的意见。

examples.zh: 他在领导面前总是唯唯诺诺。
examples.en: He's always servile in front of his bosses.

examples.zh: 不要做唯唯诺诺的应声虫。
examples.en: Don't be a spineless yes-man.

meaning.en: To grasp the main point and make everything clear and orderly.
meaning.zh: 抓住事物的关键，使条理分明。

equivalents: get to the heart of things

examples.zh: 他的发言提纲挈领，大家一听就懂。
examples.en: His talk got to the heart of it and everyone understood at once.

examples.zh: 这本书提纲挈领地介绍了中国历史。
examples.en: This book gives a concise overview of Chinese history.
